sentences.text:
The Appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, has been filed on behalf of the Appellant/Claimants, which has been decided vide Judgment dated 31.10.2022 and a SLP No.
14811/2023 has been preferred by the Insurance Company, which is pending before the Apex Court.

2. An Application bearing CM APPL. 22708/2023 under Section 151 of Code of Civil Procedure,
1908 ('CPC' hereinafter), has been filed on behalf of the Claimant for directions to the Insurance Company, to deposit the enhanced compensation amount with interest as directed vide Order dated 31.10.2022.
Since the matter stands finally disposed of, such direction can be made only by the Court before which the Appeal is pending or in This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 22/11/2024 at 23:39:24 execution of the Award.
3. There are no further directions required to be passed by this Court.
The Application is disposed of accordingly.
This is a digitally signed order.
